coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, canonical axion-photon coupling
notes: Paper presents a novel helioscope search using NuSTAR X-ray observations of the Sun during solar minimum (Feb 21, 2020). The constraint g_agamma ≲ 7.3×10^-12 GeV^-1 at 95% CL is stated for axion masses m_a ≲ 4×10^-7 eV and remains approximately flat (mass-independent) down to very low masses. The limit weakens for higher masses (m_a ≳ 4×10^-7 eV) due to loss of coherence in the axion-photon conversion probability. The paper explores previously unexplored parameter space up to m_a ≲ 3.4×10^-4 eV. Systematic uncertainties from solar magnetic field modeling, axion flux, and NuSTAR background are combined to give +27.6%/-21.2% total uncertainty. This is a measured exclusion limit from actual NuSTAR observations, not a projection.
